rules.rationale: Current npm audit on main reports js-yaml 4.x as a transitive high-severity dependency with no direct application-runtime exposure established by the audit. This temporary exception is limited to the named advisory while the dependency owner is identified and upgraded. The static-export site does not ship js-yaml. Expire quickly and fail closed for any other js-yaml advisory.

Current npm audit on main reports the vulnerable sharp only at node_modules/miniflare/node_modules/sharp, while the direct site sharp dependency is already on 0.35.4. The vulnerable nested copy is deploy tooling under miniflare/wrangler and is not shipped in the static export. This temporary exception is limited to the named advisory until wrangler/miniflare consumes patched sharp 0.35.4+; fail closed for any other sharp advisory or direct-runtime occurrence.
